name: Linktel Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Linktel Technologies Co., Ltd. focuses on the research and development, production, and sale of optical communication modules in China and internationally. Its optical module products are mainly composed of optical devices, functional circuits and optical interfaces; optical transmitting components TOSA, optical receiver components ROSA, printed circuit boards, integrated circuit chips, other electronic components, structural housings, and software. The company also provides pluggable transceivers; optical engines; and NPO and CPO for optical communication.
